versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Alibaba Cloud Nginx Ingress to ALB Ingress migration skill.
- Enables offline migration of Kubernetes nginx Ingress YAML to Alibaba Cloud ALB Ingress YAML, with no cluster or cloud access required.
- Analyzes annotation compatibility, performs automated conversion and mapping, and generates AlbConfig, IngressClass, and Ingress YAML files.
- Outputs a detailed migration report (in Chinese), including a DNS cutover plan.
- Accepts pasted YAML, file, or directory inputs, and guides users when input is missing.
